## Upstox Token Monitor

Replaces the Vercel cron entry `/api/cron/check-market-data-token` (see `vercel.json`) — same endpoint, same schedule, just triggered by n8n instead of Vercel so it lives alongside the other Tradosphere n8n workflows.

Upstox has no refresh token; its session token expires daily and only an interactive login can produce a new one. This route can't fix that — it just detects the failure promptly and pages an admin. See `src/app/api/cron/check-market-data-token/route.ts` for the full rationale.

**Do not remove the Vercel cron entry until this workflow has been verified to fire correctly on its own schedule.**

## Credential

**Check Upstox Token** needs an HTTP Header Auth credential named `Market Data Cron Auth`:

- Header name: `Authorization`
- Header value: `Bearer <CRON_SECRET>` (the same `CRON_SECRET` env var the Vercel deployment uses)

If a credential with that name already exists in this n8n instance, reuse it — otherwise create it once and it'll be reusable for other Tradosphere cron migrations.

nodes.name: Check Upstox Token
nodes.notes: Mirrors the Vercel cron entry for this path (GET, weekdays, 03:00-10:00 UTC ≈ 08:30-15:30 IST market hours). The route alerts admins internally on an ok->not-ok transition, so this node just needs to fire on schedule.
